To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the meaning of an image is not intrinsic, but emerges through user interaction and that image databases should support the manipulation of the relation between images.
(i) image meaning is emergent, (ii) image meaning is context dependent, (iii) image meaning is user dependent, and (iv) image meaning is interaction dependent.
the semantics of an image is the relation between it and other images, and that this relation can only be defined by interaction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new approach to image databases, where the semantics of the image database is emergent and the user can actively participate in the process.
the development of a model and a user interface that supports a flexible and intuitive manipulation of images in an image database.
the development of an image database that allows for the creation of emergent semantics by the users through the interaction with the database.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the semantics of images is not fixed but emerges through interaction.

the semantic content of images can not be defined independently of the context in which it is used and that, in order to provide the users with a flexible and effective way of interacting with image databases, it is necessary to provide them with a flexible way of manipulating not only images, but also their semantic context.
, while the semantic gap between low-level features and high-level semantics is still a challenge, the gap between high-level semantics and user needs is a more immediate and pressing problem.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the meaning of images is emergent from the interaction of users with images and with the relations between images.
we have developed an interface for image databases that supports the interaction with images in a way that is consistent with their semantics.
, in the image database context, semantics is not a property of the individual images, it is an emergent property of the interaction between the user and the images in a database.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the meaning of an image is not fixed and can evolve through the interaction between users and the database.
the semantics of an image database should emerge from the interaction of the users, rather than being imposed by the system.
image semantics is not a static property of images, but emerges as users interact with them.
